ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high ratio of dark-to-light pixels, approximately 19:1, with a dominant low-intensity (black/dark-grey) background and localized high-intensity (white) clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity field across 95% of visible surface. High-intensity circular geometric blobs distributed non-uniformly across both lobes. A prominent vertical high-intensity linear segment is mapped at the center-bottom insertion point.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edges of both lobes; extreme pixel-level jaggedness and irregularity localized at the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the trailing edge originating from the median notch and extending toward the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular rings (rosettes) distributed across both lobes, with significant clusters identified on the upper-outer region of the left lobe and the terminal tip of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent white vertical scar or pigmentation streak at the fluke-peduncle junction; severe asymmetrical erosion and jaggedness at the terminal lobe tips.
